items.title: Persist the reopen reason into the phase_transition audit event
items.context: buildPhaseTransitionProcessEvent (transition-orchestrator.ts) gains optional transitionType/reason appended only when defined; the call site passes { transitionType: 'reopen', reason: args.reason?.trim() } only when eventType === 'REOPEN'. Normal transitions must keep a byte-identical event shape so the flow-stability deepEqual shape test and all phase_transition consumers stay green. Reference: commit 05385c9.

happy.desc: A PLAN->INIT reopen with a valid reason appends a phase_transition event whose reason matches verbatim and whose transitionType is 'reopen', read back from the real persisted JSONL

edge.desc: A normal (non-REOPEN) transition produces a phase_transition event with neither transitionType nor reason, byte-identical to the pre-change shape

adversarial.desc: A reopen refused for a missing or too-short reason leaves the phase at PLAN and appends no event claiming a successful PLAN->INIT transition

items.title: Correct the overstated REOPEN checklist-reset atomicity comment
items.context: The reset (writeChecklist) and the phase write (writeStory) are two separate fs writes under a mkdir persist claim: concurrency-atomic and ordered so the phase write lands last, but not crash-transactional. Reword 'land together or not at all' to state the real guarantee and why the residual failure direction is the safe one. Comment-only. Reference: commit de46617.

happy.desc: The REOPEN checklist-reset comment states the real guarantee: concurrency-atomic via the mkdir persist claim, ordered so the phase write lands last

edge.desc: The phrase 'land together or not at all' no longer appears in that comment

adversarial.desc: The comment does not claim crash-transactionality anywhere, and explicitly names the residual crash window as the safe direction

items.title: Clarify the scope of the dev_start worktree prune
items.context: pruneWorktreeRegistry (worktree.ts) runs `git worktree prune --expire now`, which cannot remove a live sibling worktree but does clear every currently-missing registration repo-wide, not just the calling story's. Document both facts so callers do not rely on it being story-scoped. Comment-only. Reference: commit 48b82c0.
